title: Wrap up at a clean cut
quote: Yes: wrap up at a clean cut.
means: This session ends at a clean cut, not at the goal's end. aip-31df's checkpoint 1 lands, aip-836d runs its migration once and every thread merges it. Each open intent is then parked with its next step written in its record: aip-6fb1 checkpoint 4 and Gate B; aip-836d checkpoints 2 to 4 after the migration; aip-59ad's build after the goal pull request to main; aip-f4e2 to aip-c455 not started. The session record is updated, the finished threads are archived, and a new session picks up from brain prime.
